page: UpCloud STARTER-2xCPU-4GB is an entry-tier virtual server provisioned on KVM hypervisors, tailored for lightweight utility tasks and cost-conscious deployments. The instance provides 2 shared vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores powered by the AMD EPYC 9575F processor at a base frequency of 2.0 GHz. Supporting the x86_64 architecture, the CPU incorporates 16 MB of L3 cache along with modern instruction set extensions including AVX-512 with VNNI and BF16, AES cryptography, and SHA extensions. The machine configuration bundles 4.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB per core, alongside 30 GB of local SSD storage and 1 complimentary public IPv4 address. It contains no dedicated GPU hardware.

Benchmark results highlight strong single-threaded performance driven by the modern AMD EPYC architecture, with stress-ng single-core scoring in the top 10 percent at 3802.38 and Geekbench single-core registering 2202.0. Single-threaded compression tasks perform exceptionally well, achieving 41.86 GB/sec in gzip. Conversely, aggregate multi-threaded capacity remains constrained by the 2 shared-core allocation, reflected in weak bottom-quartile results for Geekbench multi-core (3343.0), multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and PassMark database operations (2457.63). Memory bandwidth reaches 68.79 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 50.39 GB/sec for writes.

Because the CPU resources are shared rather than dedicated, compute capacity is subject to potential neighbor contention during prolonged saturation. However, the inclusion of bundled SSD storage and balanced single-core speed provides efficient baseline economics for low-utilization footprints. UpCloud STARTER-2xCPU-4GB is technically suited for lightweight web serving, edge reverse proxies, Redis caching, microservices, internal development environments, and auxiliary CI/CD build nodes that do not require heavy continuous parallel execution.

The hardware profile includes 4.0 GB of memory, 30 GB of bundled local SSD storage, and 1 included public IPv4 address, with no GPU acceleration. Its AMD x86_64 architecture supports advanced vector instructions including AVX-512, contributing to top-tier single-core CPU throughput and rapid single-threaded compression performance. Due to the two-core shared configuration, multi-core throughput and parallel compilation remain limited, landing in the lower benchmark quartiles. UpCloud STARTER-2xCPU-4GB represents an efficient entry-level allocation suited for lightweight web serving, Redis caches, staging environments, and basic microservice hosting.
